versions.changelog: 1.0.9: EURC disclosed (trustline verification only, never a payment token); prominent irreversibility warnings — verify destination/chain/token/memo/amount before funding; USDT pay-in table states Base is USDC-only in both directions.

1.0.8: auto-execute now ships OFF. Confirmation thresholds default to 0/0, so every payment — any amount — shows full details and waits for an explicit yes/no. Small-amount auto-execute still exists but is strictly opt-in: the user raises the thresholds in version.json themselves (now shipped inside the artifact). Same consent shape as stellar-agent-wallet's --max-auto.

1.0.7: explicit pay-in (source) vs pay-out (destination) direction labels with a glossary — the Solana USDT asymmetry is now stated outright; parse-qr requires the user to confirm the decoded recipient/chain/token/amount before any payment flow (QR input is attacker-controllable); check-balance discloses that supplied addresses are transmitted to Rozo's balance API.

1.0.6: removes the instructions that told the agent to probe .stellar-secret / read wallet keys out of .env to pick a source chain. The user names the wallet, or the agent asks — a payment skill must never discover secrets on its own.

Security-audit release: removed the incorrect Base row from the USDT tables (the listed address was the Base USDC contract; the Rozo API does not support USDT on Base, so Base is now documented as USDC-only and the code mapping was fixed), full supported chain list (adds Arbitrum and Polygon) in the description, up-front disclosure that payments at or below the configurable thresholds ($1 silent / $10 narrated by default) auto-execute without a yes/no prompt, crypto-scoped trigger phrases that exclude fiat/bank questions, a data-sent-to-Rozo privacy note where the endpoints are documented, and a declared permissions block (network endpoints, no env vars, no filesystem, spending behavior, no subprocesses).
1.0.4: catches the listing up with the repo (ClawHub had 1.0.2). Rebuilt from RozoAI/rozo-intents-skills main.

- Updated skill version to 1.0.2 and added explicit Node.js runtime requirements.
- Documented public, rate-limited API endpoints.
- Clarified scripts usage and runtime in documentation.

- Initial public release of skill v1.0.1 with full source controlled under Git.
- Adds ability to send cross-chain crypto payments and bridging via Rozo, supporting USDC/USDT on Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain, Solana, and Stellar.
- Includes intent detection and routing for sending payments, checking balances, payment status, and parsing QR codes.
- Provides Node.js scripts for checking balances, creating payments, getting payment status, parsing QR codes, and verifying Stellar trustlines.
- Documentation covers supported chains, tokens, usage rules, resource references, and quick start info.

Initial release of Rozo cross-chain crypto payments skill.

- Supports sending USDC/USDT across EVM chains (Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, BSC, Polygon), Solana, and Stellar.
- Detects wallet addresses, transaction hashes, payment UUIDs, and QR codes; routes to relevant payment or information functions.
- Auto-selects token based on balance (USDC preferred), checks fees, requires user confirmation before sending.
- Four main intents: send payment, check wallet balance, parse QR code, and check payment status.
- Includes Node.js scripts for balance checking, trustline verification, payment creation, status lookup, and QR parsing.
- Reference docs included for supported chains, API endpoints, and address detection rules.
